## Objective
- Build a complete, playable 3D Call-of-Duty-inspired Warzone-style survival FPS game and verify it in-browser.

## Requirements
- 3D playable combat experience.
- Mobile and desktop support.
- No clarifying questions; reasonable assumptions allowed.

- Created an original tactical FPS presentation rather than using branded Call of Duty assets or names.
- Used Three.js for 3D rendering and lightweight CSS/DOM HUD.
- Assumed a persistent browser game with endless enemy waves.

- Built the full game shell and responsive military HUD in `index.html` and `style.css`.

- Added desktop mouse/keyboard and mobile touch controls.
